name: @mcpbytes/omp-memory
description: MCPBytes Memory for omp: recalls the user's memories at the start of a session and saves durable decisions to a per-project space.

apiKey.description: MCPBytes API key (console.mcpbytes.com, API keys). Without one the plugin stays off.

space.description: Memory space for this project. Default: the repository's name. Set it per project in .omp/plugin-overrides.json

autoRecall.description: Recall relevant memories and due intentions for the first request of a session (charged only when a match by meaning is found)

retainNudge.description: After a run of 5 or more tool calls that saved nothing, ask the agent once whether something is worth remembering
